decisive_items: TSC1 gene mutation (15 exon c.1690 G > T, p.E564*)
Subcortical tubers in white matter of frontal lobes
response.rationale: TSC1 mutation and characteristic features (rhabdomyoma, tubers) confirm TSC; SEGA is a complication but not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Cardiac rhabdomyoma is a feature of TSC, not the primary diagnosis.
SEGA is a possible tumor but the overall syndrome is TSC.
Depigmented spots are not melanosis; no melanocytic nevi.
Histopathology is not typical for rhabdoid tumor; TSC is more consistent.
